sentences.en: In 1954 he completed the restoration of the chapel, which was ravaged by death-watch beetle.

sentences.en: He had said that it was neither functional nor aesthetically pleasing and that there was death-watch beetle in the roof.

sentences.en: Now that the banks aren't on deathwatch, Ken Lewis's perch atop Bank of America (BAC) looks secure.

sentences.en: Daddy's last days brought a classic country deathwatch into our house.

sentences.en: It was suggested that deathwatch could alleviate the pain to the sick children and effectively raise the last quality of living.

sentences.en: So why is much of the music industry on a Death Row deathwatch?
